premise: Duckling isn't sure about the pond and hides his head under his wing; Snail shows him that he hides too when things are new — and then peeks out, just a little — so Duckling peeks, dips one orange foot, then the other, and his webbed feet push like paddles: he floats!
inspiration: The Ugly Duckling (Andersen), turned: nobody is unkind, and he finds his place by trying, one foot at a time.
learning: Ducks paddle with their webbed feet.

en-US.title: Duckling Dares the Water
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.7 20s} [softly] It was a warm, sunny morning. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Frog sat in the pond, {frog:live} catching flies. Snap! Gulp! {frog:face happy} Come on in, {duckling:enter} Duckling! {duckling:go to pond} Duckling waddled up to the edge. {duckling:face sad} The water looked very big. And very wet. [whispers] Maybe tomorrow, he said, and {duckling:live hold} tucked his head under his wing. Slowly, slowly, up crawled {snail:enter} Snail. [curious] Are you hiding? he asked. I hide too, when something's new. Like this. {snail:live hold} In he went. Then… {snail:live resume} out he peeked, just a tiny bit. {duckling:live resume} Duckling peeked out too. One orange foot went in. {sfx:splash} Plip. The other went in. Plop. And then… {duckling:go to pond another by swim} his webbed feet pushed the water like paddles, push, push, and he was floating! {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] I'm swimming! {duckling:face happy} {duckling:hop x2} {frog:hop x2} {sfx:quack} QUACK! {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] Snail smiled from the edge. He wasn't going in. But he'd come and watch. Every single day.

es-ES.title: Patito se atreve con el agua
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.7 20s} [softly] Era una mañana de sol calentito. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Rana estaba en la charca, {frog:live} cazando moscas. ¡Zas! ¡Glup! {frog:face happy} ¡Métete, {duckling:enter} Patito! {duckling:go to pond} Patito se acercó a la orilla, bamboleándose. {duckling:face sad} El agua parecía muy grande. Y muy mojada. [whispers] Mejor mañana, dijo, y {duckling:live hold} escondió la cabeza bajo el ala. Despacito, despacito, llegó {snail:enter} Caracol. [curious] ¿Te estás escondiendo? le preguntó. Yo también me escondo cuando algo es nuevo. Así. {snail:live hold} Y se metió en su concha. Luego… {snail:live resume} asomó, solo un poquito. {duckling:live resume} Patito también asomó. Metió una pata naranja. {sfx:splash} Plic. Metió la otra. Ploc. Y entonces… {duckling:go to pond another by swim} sus patas palmeadas empujaron el agua como remos, y… ¡flotaba! {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Estoy nadando! {duckling:face happy} {duckling:hop x2} {frog:hop x2} {sfx:quack} ¡CUA! {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] Caracol sonreía desde la orilla. Él no pensaba meterse. Pero vendría a mirar. Todos los días.
